jobs.prompt:
FILE ACCESS: your declared outputs are readable. Train 9 tin 2: ONE SOURCE FOR ALL COUNTS.

The owner sees different numbers for the same project on the two Command Center pages. Live project-swarm example: Hive card 408 tickets / p(done) 58% / 8 need you, Cockpit 407 tickets / 57% done / 5 need you; the Hive 'ready to start' figure and the Cockpit READY tile also disagree (Hive uses dependency-aware ready, Cockpit counts every todo+ready because the cockpit ledger payload has no dependsOn). Root causes: (1) the snapshot builds Hive counts from projects[].tickets.byStatus (ticketsOf: excludes human tickets, total INCLUDES cancelled), while the cockpit counts its ledger rows (includes human, excludes cancelled, but has no dependsOn/type); (2) needs-you is derived client-side in the cockpit as review + human-status (5) instead of using the owner inbox count the board already computes (8); (3) the cockpit derives 'ready' from stripped rows (70 instead of 15).

Goal: compute the counts ONCE on the server from the full ledger and have both pages render those exact numbers. No client may re-derive any headline count.

CANONICAL DEFINITIONS (write these in one function and one test):
- counted/live tickets = all ledger tickets whose status is NOT cancelled, proposed or superseded. Human (type 'human') tickets ARE included. This is the one 'tickets' number.
- done = live tickets with status done. percentDone = round(100 times done divided by total), 0 when total is 0. remaining = total - done.
- ready = dependency-aware runnable tickets: status todo or ready, no unapproved proposal origin (comment/error/handoff without approvedBy owner), and every dependsOn id is done. Reuse the existing readyTickets() in tools/tickets.mjs; do not write a second definition.
- review/blocked/todo/cancelled/proposed/superseded counts come from the same live set (cancelled/proposed/superseded reported for the footer but not part of total).
- needsYou = the owner-inbox item count the board already puts in card.blocked.needYou (see tools/board-inbox.mjs). Never recompute it from ticket statuses in a browser.

IMPLEMENT:
1. NEW tools/ticket-counts.mjs: export `ticketCountsOf(ledger)` returning { total, done, ready, review, blocked, todo, cancelled, proposed, superseded, remaining, percentDone, counted } using the definitions above (counted === total). Import readyTickets from './tickets.mjs'. Pure and deterministic; tolerate a null/empty ledger (all zeros, total 0, percentDone 0).
2. tools/board-data.mjs: in BOTH projectOverview() and projectDetail() returns, add `counts: ticketCountsOf(ledger)` next to the existing `ledger:` field (the same selected full ledger; not the stripped commandCenterLedger). Do not add needsYou there (the inbox merge already sets card.blocked.needYou). Do not change existing fields.
3. tools/command-center-snapshot.mjs:
   - buildProjectCard: card.ticketCounts must come from p.counts when present, merged with needsYou: p.card.blocked.needYou, and percentDone from counts.percentDone. Keep the exact key names total, done, ready, blocked, review, cancelled, remaining, counted, percentDone, needsYou, source (source: '<prefix>.counts'). Fallback when p.counts is absent: derive the same canonical shape from p.ledger.tickets statuses (ready = status ready count when dependency data is absent), then from p.tickets.byStatus only if there is no ledger. Never prefer byStatus over counts/ledger when both exist.
   - Add a top-level `totals` plain object to buildCommandCenterSnapshot: { tickets, done, ready, review, blocked, todo, cancelled, percentDone, needsYou } summed/graded from the project cards (one source; percentDone = round(100 times done divided by tickets)). Expose it on the snapshot and recompute it in patchCommandCenterSnapshot (do not leave it stale).
   - buildProjectCockpit: add `counts: card counts` to the returned payload, same canonical shape (including needsYou from project.card.blocked.needYou, and percentDone), and keep ledger/meta unchanged. Also include top-level `percentDone` if not already derivable from counts.
   - patchCommandCenterSnapshot: rebuild the changed cards from p.counts, recompute snapshot.totals, and keep stats.needsYouCount/agentsLive/hive behavior. Tests must prove a patched board and a full rebuild agree on every total.
4. tools/watch-assets/hive-panels.js: cardCounts() must read the canonical shape; `counted` = counts.counted (do not subtract cancelled again when total is already live). projectView() must use counts.percentDone for pct when present (fallback to done/counted). deriveHiveView totals should prefer snapshot.totals when it is present, otherwise sum cards exactly as today. Keep every existing rendered label; only the numbers change.
5. tools/watch-assets/cockpit-lists.js: HIDDEN_STATUSES must include superseded so rows match the canonical live set.
6. tools/watch-assets/cc-cockpit-mount.js: use the server payload `project.counts` for every headline/stat: headerCounters (tickets/done/need you/agents), the NOW card ready count, the TICKET STACK big number and tiles (ready, review, waiting/blocked, to do, done), and the footer cancelled/proposed text. Rows still come from the ledger; only displayed aggregates use counts. Fallback to the current derivation when project.counts is absent (older payloads/tests), but the fallback must never override counts. Remove the review+human needsYou guess when counts.needsYou exists.
7. TESTS: add tests/command-center-counts.test.mjs covering:
   - ticketCountsOf: cancelled/proposed/superseded excluded; human included; dependency-aware ready (todo with an unfinished dependency is not ready; ready with a done dependency is); unapproved proposal not ready; percent rounding and empty ledger.
   - Snapshot with a project whose p.counts disagrees with p.tickets.byStatus: card.ticketCounts and snapshot.totals use counts, not byStatus.
   - Cross-page regression on ONE board fixture: build the snapshot and buildProjectCockpit for the same project; assert Hive card total/done/percentDone/ready/needsYou equal the Cockpit payload counts exactly, and that the cockpit READY/tickets values are not the stripped-ledger sums. Also assert the Hive derived totals.ready (load hive-panels.js or use snapshot.totals) equals the cockpit counts.ready.
   - patchCommandCenterSnapshot: change a project's counts + needsYou, patch one id, and assert card, totals, and needsYou match a fresh build from the same board.
   - A real-shape payload test that carries the stripped commandCenterLedger (no dependsOn/type) plus counts; assert counts still win.
   Update existing tests only where they encoded the old divergent behavior (tests/command-center-snapshot.test.mjs 'project cards carry ledger counts by status...' should now assert the canonical counts; keep an explicit fallback test for a payload with no counts). Do not weaken or delete existing assertions for money fields, live patches, or hive rendering.

CONSTRAINTS: no hard-coded sample data; no client-side recomputation of headline counts; no new dependencies; keep the Command Center payload money-free; keep behavior on a board without any ledger (zeros/muted text, no 'undefined'); do not touch version files or the soak/latency harnesses.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/command-center-counts.test.mjs tests/command-center-snapshot.test.mjs tests/command-center-hive.test.mjs tests/command-center-hive-panels.test.mjs tests/command-center-lists.test.mjs tests/command-center-live.test.mjs tests/cc-cockpit-mount.test.mjs tests/board-accuracy-percent.test.mjs -> all pass.
